translations.EN: I heard you. Give me a second.
translations.TL: Narinig kita. Bigyan mo ako ng sandali.

translations.EN: Heard that proposition. Let me catch my breath.
translations.TL: Narinig ang alok na 'yan. Huminga muna ako.

translations.EN: I heard you clearly. Hold on for a moment.
translations.TL: Narinig kita nang malinaw. Maghintay nang sandali.

translations.EN: Message received loud and clear. Give me a minute.
translations.TL: Nakuha ang mensahe nang malinaw. Bigyan mo ako ng sandali.

translations.EN: I heard that. Give me a beat to think.
translations.TL: Narinig ko 'yon. Bigyan mo ako ng oras para mag-isip.

translations.EN: Heard. That's a lot to process right now.
translations.TL: Narinig. Napakabigat iproseso niyan sa ngayon.

translations.EN: I heard what you just proposed. Just hold up.
translations.TL: Narinig ko ang inalok mo. Teka lang muna.

translations.EN: Got that. Let me gather my thoughts.
translations.TL: Nakuha 'yon. Tipunin ko muna ang isip ko.

translations.EN: I heard you. Don't rush me.
translations.TL: Narinig kita. Huwag mo akong madaliin.

translations.EN: Heard every word. Give me some room.
translations.TL: Narinig ang bawat salita. Bigyan mo ako ng puwang.

translations.EN: That is a bold thing to say.
translations.TL: Matapang na bagay ang sabihin iyan.

translations.EN: You don't waste time with subtlety, do you?
translations.TL: Di ka nagsasayang ng oras sa pahiwatig, 'no?

translations.EN: That's about as blunt as it gets out here.
translations.TL: Kasing-prangka na 'yan ng kahit ano rito.

translations.EN: You're taking quite a gamble saying that.
translations.TL: Malaking sugal ang pagsasabi niyan.

translations.EN: That's an audacious thing to drop on me.
translations.TL: Napakapangahas na bagay ang ibagsak sa akin.

translations.EN: You definitely speak your mind without filters.
translations.TL: Nagsasalita ka talaga nang walang preno.

translations.EN: Bold proposition. Let's see what happens.
translations.TL: Matapang na alok. Tingnan natin ang mangyayari.

translations.EN: That takes some serious nerve to put out there.
translations.TL: Nangangailangan ng tunay na tapang para ilatag 'yan.

translations.EN: You're playing with high stakes with that talk.
translations.TL: Naglalaro ka sa mataas na pustahan sa salitang 'yan.

translations.EN: Direct and daring. Noted.
translations.TL: Diretso at mapangahas. Tala ko na.
